top_claim.text: This educational case study transparently characterizes its specified simulated mechanisms, evidence and unresolved hazards.

argument: Combine reproducibility, mechanism verification, adverse evaluation and explicit defeaters; do not infer acceptable real-world risk.
context: No real vehicles/hardware or physical independent actuation
Same automation in reviewer roles, no accredited independent assessment
assumptions: Trusted local FFI and shared simulation clock

claims.claim: Nominal configured decision thresholds are exercised; universal timely avoidance is not claimed.
Configured MAC/authorization/freshness rejection is supported under public-fixture-key assumptions.
Specified detectable sensor/communication/achieved-braking faults are indicated in tested budgets.
counterexamples: Detection cannot restore missing bandwidth/physical braking

claims.claim: Newest-authenticated route selection and bounded diagnostic recovery follow tested contracts.
counterexamples: No aggregate collision reduction in final set
All usable paths stale/lost remain open

claims.claim: Specified detectable invalid-input modes have defined native degradation behavior.
counterexamples: Plausible errors and compromised intent can escape validity checks

claims.claim: Perception/braking limitations are compared with preserved negative results.
Evidence integrity, requirement/test linkage and known lifecycle/model gaps are reviewable.
counterexamples: Language validity is not engineering equivalence

open_limitations: Partial structural coverage and ASan unvalidated
No ISO/AUTOSAR conformance, homologation or production-readiness claim
